sentences.text:
Briz Lal Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18
January, 2023
Author: Saumitra Dayal Singh

Bench: Saumitra Dayal Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 64
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 26081 of 2018
Applicant :- Briz Lal Vishwakarma

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Seema Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,D.K. Yadav,Shri Prakash Dwivedi,D.K. Yadav,D.K. Yadav
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1.
Heard Ms. Seema Mishra learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. Present application has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 09.5.2016 and the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 717 of 2018 arising out of Case Crime No. 401 of 2015, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506, 354, 376 IPC, Police Station Haliya, District Mirzapur, Pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II Mirzapur.
3. Submission is, parties belong to the same family.
Earlier occasioned by matrimonial discord in the marriage of opposite party No. 2 with the son of the applicant, exaggerated and false allegations came to be made against the applicant.
No such occurrence had ever taken place and no injury had been caused and no offence was committed.

Briz Lal Vishwakarma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12024147/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During pendency of present proceedings, parties have been able to resolve their difference such that the opposite party No. 2 does realise, no occurrence took place.
She has stated the same in the written settlement reached between the parties dated 26.4.2019.

Same has also been verified by the learned court below vide order dated 13.9.2022 passed by the Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division) Court No. 4 Mirzapur in Case No. 717 of 2018, State Vs. Brij Lal Vishwakarma.

entities.text: Additional Civil Judge (Junior Division) Court No. 4 Mirzapur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Certified copy of the settlement thus reached between the parties and certified copy of the order passed thereon have been placed on record and marked as 'Y' and 'X' respectively.

5. In such circumstances, though no useful purpose would be served in allowing the prosecution to continue any further, however, no firm conclusion may be reached, at this stage, as to complete falsity of the allegations made against the applicants.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application thus stands allowed.

6. The charge sheet dated 09.5.2016 and the proceedings of Criminal Case No. 717 of 2018 arising out of Case Crime No. 401 of 2015, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354, 376 IPC, Police Station Haliya, District Mirzapur, Pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-II Mirzapur are quashed insofar as it relates to applicant.
7.

entities.text: Police Station Haliya, District Mirzapur, Pending
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: However, it is left open to the opposite party No. 2 to seek recall of this order, if just cause survives.
